title: Fee Submission Deadline Extended for Spring Semester 2026
text:
Fee Submission Notice – Spring Semester 2026

In response to requests from students, the Hon’ble Vice Chancellor has approved an extension in the fee submission deadline for the Spring Semester 2026. Students may now deposit their fees without late charges until April 10, 2026.

After the revised deadline, a late fee of Rs. 1,000 per day will be applicable.

Students facing financial difficulties may avail the facility of an easy installment plan.

For any fee-related issues or assistance, students are advised to contact the Students Cell at the Treasurer Office.
